summary_en: OHMORIYA executed a block purchase of 35,000 shares (0.70% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) at 891 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on October 9, 2026, for a total outlay of 31.185 million yen, to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On October 8, 2026, OHMORIYA's Board of Directors authorized a block purchase of treasury stock to be executed on October 9, 2026. The company placed an order to purchase up to 35,000 shares of its common stock via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours trading) at the closing price of 891 yen per share recorded on October 8, 2026. The order was placed at the opening of the 8:45 a.m. trading session on October 9 and was valid only for that session. The total outlay was limited to 31.185 million yen. The 35,000 shares represented 0.70% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock (4,965,032 shares as of September 30, 2026). As of the same date, OHMORIYA held 133,064 shares of treasury stock. The purchase was conducted to enable flexible and dynamic capital allocation policies responsive to changes in the business environment.
